implementation.requestSnapshotLimitation: The durable job stores only request fingerprints, not the exact accepted request snapshot. The candidate helper cannot verify that APPLIED glossaryApplication.exactGlossaryRef equals the exact submitted glossary ref, or that NOT_REQUESTED corresponds to omission. It rejects fillerRetakeCandidateObservations because their request/source-time conditions also cannot be checked. Keep this helper package-private and candidate-only until an additive bounded request snapshot is persisted through the canonical job/attempt path.
implementation.independentReview: Luna reviewed the final binding path, additive migration, package-private readback, concurrent retry behavior and fingerprint-domain fix. It found no migration or package-boundary blocker, but withheld exact PDP validation and logical task completion pending the accepted request snapshot and request-relative glossary checks.
